mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL annualized increase > 2% does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between CPIAUCSL and 20-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increase > 0.5% does not lead to negative 5-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between UNRATE and 5-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for 3 consecutive months do not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between RSAFS and 60-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals strengthening supply-side activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increase > 1% does not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between INDPRO and 20-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and CPIAUCSL is above 2%, the combination signals a potential overheating economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the combination of FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL > 2% does not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the joint effect is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) over three consecutive months signals strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If sustained increase in PAYEMS does not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between PAYEMS and 20-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When Housing Starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% in a month and UNRATE increases by more than 0.3%, the combination signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the combination of HOUST decline > 10% and UNRATE increase > 0.3% does not lead to negative 5-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the joint effect is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a decline in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 0.5% signals a potential supply-side slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO decline > 0.5% during late-cycle expansion does not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between INDPRO and 60-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).
